headline: Halliburton (HAL) Stock May Still Offer Value Following Q3 Earnings Reset
summary: Halliburton has delivered a 53.5% share price return over the past year, which puts a sharp spotlight on whether the current US$33.50 level is supported by the earnings that underpin the business.
